findings.scenario: 201 distinct completed phone activities in the selected period; API first page contains 200 and total=201
findings.evidenceMethod: Synthetic browser API fixture on the published frontend
findings.impact: Daily counters and printed history derived from a partial page undercount larger periods/portfolios
findings.remedy: Server aggregates with the same grouping rule; paginate lists and clearly delimit printed scope. Verify periods, owner, mixed states and tenant A/B.

findings.scenario: Click or press Ctrl+K on the apparent global search
findings.observed: DIV, zero inputs and zero dialogs after shortcut; notification button disabled
findings.impact: Visual affordance promises an interaction which is still planned
findings.remedy: Label planned capability visibly and remove inactive shortcut, or implement scoped keyboard search and results with server authorization.

findings.scenario: More than 100 matching tasks, including many due on the same date
findings.observed: Take(100); total count header exists, UI warns of limit and offers filters, but no next page/cursor
findings.evidenceMethod: Backend and frontend contract inspection; small current live dataset cannot reproduce large task volumes
findings.impact: Remaining matching tasks cannot be reached by pagination; history also caps at 100
findings.remedy: Paginated/cursor contracts, total count and navigation; test item 101, stable order, state filters and tenant/carteira negatives.

findings.scenario: Contact references an authorized organization sorted outside the first 100 organizations
findings.observed: Organization catalog Take(100); contact detail searches only this list and falls back to Nao vinculada
findings.evidenceMethod: Producer/consumer code trace; no production data inserted
findings.impact: Existing organization association can be presented as absent
findings.remedy: Return authorized organization name with contact details, or query related ID and paginate selector; do not infer missing association from a partial list.

findings.scenario: User chooses Enviar ao Outlook geral
findings.observed: Anchor downloads calendar.ics; automatic synchronization is a different action
findings.evidenceMethod: Code and rendered interface; export not triggered
findings.impact: Verb can be interpreted as confirmed synchronization/send
findings.remedy: Rename to Exportar agenda (.ics) and distinguish exported, connected and synchronized states.

findings.scenario: Open Clients or mobile Agenda to perform the main task
findings.observed: Large permanent registration/check panels and integration/filter notices push primary data down; no horizontal overflow
findings.impact: More scrolling and competing controls; users must scan secondary steps before work items
findings.remedy: Progressive disclosure, compact contextual notices, essential filters first and check tools near creation; preserve duplication safeguards.
